claims.supporting_data: Pooled analysis of 18 RCTs (811 patients), Level of Evidence 1.

claims.claim: PRP was superior to HA in WOMAC total, WOMAC physical function and VAS at 3, 6 and 12 months.
claims.supporting_data: Meta-analytic comparison of patient-reported outcomes across timepoints.

claims.claim: Leukocyte-rich and leukocyte-poor PRP showed no significant difference in WOMAC or VAS scores.
claims.supporting_data: Subgroup analysis of PRP formulations (LR-PRP vs LP-PRP).

claims.claim: Leukocyte-poor PRP may be superior to leukocyte-rich PRP in IKDC scores.
